summary: Offensive bulk-mail / phishing toolkit distributed as heavily obfuscated npm package
details: monogrok ships an operator-run offensive-security toolkit: bulk mailing, SMTP credential discovery via Shodan queries targeting AWS SES / SendGrid / Mailgun / Mandrill / Postmark / SparkPost, IMAP/POP3/EWS mailbox access, proxy rotation, Discord webhook result reporting, and encrypted HTML phishing page generation. Every JavaScript file in cmds/, func/, and utils/ is heavily string-array/RC4 obfuscated (hex-prefixed identifiers such as _0xf72454 pervasive across 400+ files). Auxiliary data in _init/ (bulk-from-mail.txt, senders.txt, Shodan query files, resulthook.txt referencing a Discord webhook, encryptHtml.js) confirms the phishing/bulk-mail purpose. No install lifecycle hooks are declared; operational commands run only when the operator explicitly invokes the CLI against operator-chosen external targets. There is no traced code path that reads installer-owned secrets (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, wallets, browser stores), no install-time or import-time fetch-and-execute, no exfiltration to a hardcoded author endpoint keyed off the installer's own data, and no backdoor into the installer's host. The obfuscation impedes review but on its own does not create installer-side harm.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
